# External data (not redistributed)

`LUCAS-SOIL-2018 RO.csv` — LUCAS 2018 Topsoil survey, Romanian records (laboratory pH in water, organic carbon, land cover, coordinates).
The data are distributed by the European Soil Data Centre (ESDAC, Joint Research Centre, https://esdac.jrc.ec.europa.eu) after an access request and **must not be redistributed**; request them from ESDAC, keep the Romanian records (column `NUTS_0` = RO) and save the file here under this name.
Needed only by `lucas_comparison/` and `representation_landcover/lucas_landcover_context.py`.
